summary.problem: The documentation in docs/cli/system-prompt.md uses 'SYSTEM.md' and 'system.md' inconsistently, causing confusion about whether the default system prompt file name is case-sensitive or capitalized.
summary.root_cause: The section 'Best practices: SYSTEM.md vs GEMINI.md' in docs/cli/system-prompt.md uses uppercase 'SYSTEM.md', whereas the CLI defaults to reading '.gemini/system.md' in lowercase.
summary.context: The default system prompt filename recognized by GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD is '.gemini/system.md'. Standardizing references in docs/cli/system-prompt.md to 'system.md' or '.gemini/system.md' clarifies the expected filename.

steps: Update section headers and descriptions in docs/cli/system-prompt.md to consistently reference 'system.md' or '.gemini/system.md' instead of uppercase 'SYSTEM.md'.
Clarify in docs/cli/system-prompt.md that '.gemini/system.md' is the default lowercase path read when GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD=1 is set.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The system prompt documentation consistently references '.gemini/system.md' as the default system prompt filename.
verification_steps: Review docs/cli/system-prompt.md to confirm all references to the system prompt filename consistently use '.gemini/system.md' or 'system.md'.
